 /Photo provided by SBS Actors Lee Seo-jin and Ha Ji-won are forming a subtle pink-tinted atmosphere in Singapore.
 In the upcoming episode of the SBS variety show "Will You Do Anything? - Secretary Jin" (hereinafter "Secretary Jin"), airing on the 6th, the unusual "chemistry" between Lee Seo-jin and Ha Ji-won, who are reuniting for the first time in 23 years since the drama "Damo," will unfold.
 On this day, "Secretary Jin" continues its heat by presenting the Ha Ji-won episode for two consecutive weeks for the first time in history. As the second story of Ha Ji-won's Singapore business trip is revealed as the "My Star" segment, following last week's visit to an F1 race site, they are embarking on a full-fledged Singapore tour this time.
 In particular, Lee Seo-jin shows affectionate care by directly applying sunscreen to Ha Ji-won's body under the scorching sun. A subtle atmosphere is expected to linger between the two once again, following last week.
 /Photo provided by SBS Subsequently, Ha Ji-won appears as a guest in the filming of a YouTube content by singer and broadcaster Gangnam, which is being conducted in Singapore. Before the filming, Ha Ji-won requests special care to protect herself from Gangnam's pranks. In response, Lee Seo-jin shows a reassuring demeanor, saying, "Don't worry. That's my specialty."
 In fact, as the filming begins, Lee Seo-jin keeps his gaze fixed on Ha Ji-won and stays by her side, continuing meticulous care. Curiosity is piqued about what kind of appearance Lee Seo-jin, who has transformed into a "bodyguard," will show again.
 Lee Seo-jin's reassuring care continues even during the filming. When an unexpected bet over paying for a meal unfolds, he once again protects Ha Ji-won with a sense befitting his background as a graduate of New York University's Department of Business Administration.
 Following this, Ha Ji-won challenges herself to Singapore's iconic "Giant Swing." Even in the dizzying situation of hanging suspended in mid-air, Lee Seo-jin does not lose his duty as a "bodyguard" and continues "stabilizing care" by Ha Ji-won's side, who has acrophobia. Attention is drawn to Lee Seo-jin's "Ha Ji-won doting" aspect as he stays by her side throughout the schedule. The episode airs at 11:10 p.m. on the 6th.
